name: @uselessworks/svgify
description: Deterministic, print-oriented image quantization and SVG vectorization in TypeScript.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @uselessworks/svgify-cli && npm run build -w @svgify/demo
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @svgify/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @uselessworks/svgify-cli && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
